entities.name: Francis Hallé
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Francis Hallé was a French botanist and biologist. He was a specialist on tropical rainforests and of tree architecture. He is best known for the first "Radeau des cimes" he initiated with an aerostatic balloon in 1986. He was a Professor Emeritus at the University of Montpellier.
